slots={'7':(0,0),'8':(0,7),'3':(7,0),'2':(7,7)}
cand=[[0]*14 for _ in range(14)]
for col,(r0,c0) in slots.items():
  for r in range(7):

      cand[r0+r][c0+c]=trans[col][r][c] or int(col)
# add appendages oriented inward

cand[3][6]=8
for r in [7,8]: cand[r][10]=8
for c in [7,8,9]: cand[10][c]=3
print(json.dumps(cand,separators=(',',':')))

8:{(r,c) for r in range(7) for c in range(7)}}
extras={7:{(-3,3),(-2,3),(-1,3)},3:{(3,-3),(3,-2),(3,-1)},2:set(),8:{(3,7),(7,3),(8,3)}}
# D4 transformations around n x n square, formulas
T={
'I':lambda r,c:(r,c),
'R90':lambda r,c:(c,6-r),
'R180':lambda r,c:(6-r,6-c),
'R270':lambda r,c:(6-c,r),
'H':lambda r,c:(r,6-c),
'V':lambda r,c:(6-r,c),
'D':lambda r,c:(c,r),
'AD':lambda r,c:(6-c,6-r),}
# Need transformations of extras use same affine formulas; works outside.

  for t7 in ['R180','AD']:

      valid.append((ass.copy(),trforms.copy(),exset))
